summary:
Submitted a research product that maps the last unread protocol boundary instead of leaving it deferred.

Context from the index: three findings are confirmed_in_scope, the restart check is accepted as a bounded negative, map v8 is the accepted basis, audit units are exhausted, and pending_work is empty.

Product contents (draft-relative submission.json with the updated map.json and one newly acquired source range SR-RECOVER = api.go 313-440):

Reading RecoverCluster shows it refuses to run without existing state, restores the newest snapshot it can open and fails when none can be restored, applies only LogCommand entries from the log tail while advancing lastIndex/lastTerm over every scanned entry, writes a new snapshot carrying the operator-supplied configuration at configuration index 1, and deletes the whole stored log range so stored configuration entries cannot interfere. That is now a sourced behavior b-offline-recovery (A3) with an A4 cross-activity effect recording the forced installation of a configuration outside the membership protocol, the emptied log, and the caller's FSM being left in the recovered state.

The former deferred surface BootstrapCluster/RecoverCluster becomes mapped to that behavior, and the target profile no longer lists the boundary as unread; only the raft-compat test module remains outside this run. The map changes carry explicit rationale plus a preserves statement so no existing proposition is affected, and the feedback records the boundary description, its new residual (whether force-installing the configuration at index 1 interacts with the configuration-change gate on the next start) and the remaining frontier, noting that unit admission exhaustion keeps these as premises rather than new obligations. No defect is claimed for this entry point: it is the documented unsafe, operator-invoked reset.

Preflight `validate` returned valid=true with no diagnostics. Acceptance and the final map version remain with the controller.
